=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text lq "<<<"
text rq ">>>"
text tlen " length "
text c0 "\"If I were two-faced, would I be wearing this one?\" --- Abraham Lincoln "
text c1 "..1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111117777888"
text c2 "I never give 'em hell, I just tell the truth, and they think it's hell. "
text c3 "                                                    --- Harry S Truman  "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
fn line a view uchar * to void
emit lq
emit a
emit rq
emit tlen
emitu len a
emit nl
end
note collapse keeps a byte only when it differs from the byte before it
fn collapse a view uchar * to void
o = new uchar 256 0
n = ulong 0
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
k = true
if gt i 0
k = ne c get a sub i 1
end
if k
put o n c
n = add n 1
end
end
line a
line part o 0 n
end
fn main to int
note the empty string, as a slice of length 0
collapse part c0 0 0
collapse c0
collapse c1
collapse c2
collapse c3
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
